Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment kickoff — identity mapping & PO workflow checklist

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the vendor enrollment with Redwood Inference. To get your account created in our procurement portal and ensure POs route correctly, we need a couple of items from your side and a quick identity-mapping check: 

- Legal entity name (exactly as shown on tax docs) + any DBA names you use
- Tax ID / VAT registration (PDF) — we reference this for tax validation in Coupa/Ivalua
- Remittance address, invoice email, and preferred PO format (e.g., PO-12345 or numeric only)
- Signed vendor enrollment form (attached is our checklist to walk you through fields)

I saw your team attempted to self-register earlier; if the portal rejects the account for a name mismatch we can do a manual provision, but we need the above docs to avoid duplicate entities. I attached the kickoff checklist and a short onboarding form to speed things up.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_kickoff_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet checklist)

Next steps: If you can return the tax PDF and the completed enrollment form by end of day Wed (US PST), Vanessa can provision a temporary account while we reconcile entity mapping. I'll also loop in Procurement (Marcus) to confirm PO routing.

Appreciate it —

Mina Haddad
Program Manager, Partner Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment kickoff — identity mapping & PO workflow checklist

Hi Mina —

Thanks — attaching our tax packet. We did try to create the account in Coupa earlier today but the portal returned an "identity mismatch" error. Our legal name is ClearWave Health, Inc.; we often register invoices under the DBA "ClearWave Managed Services" which I suspect is what's tripping the validation.

Quick answers:
- Legal name: ClearWave Health, Inc. (attached: clearwave_tax_info.pdf)
- DBA: ClearWave Managed Services (we use DBA on invoices occasionally)
- Remit email: invoices@clearwave.com
- Preferred PO format: CLEAR-#### (e.g., CLEAR-1001)

If you can provision the account manually and map the DBA to the legal entity that would be ideal. We also have a standard W-9 and VAT cert in the attached packet.

Let me know if you need the enrollment form filled out in a particular format or via DocuSign — happy to route internally.

Best,

Alicia Gomez
Senior Procurement Lead
ClearWave Health

Mina / Vanessa —

Forwarding Alicia's note. Short questions from Procurement: 

- Can Platform Ops (Vanessa) do a one-off manual provisioning in Ivalua/Coupa and associate the DBA to the legal entity to unblock POs?
- If we manual-provision, will that create a duplicate vendor entity if ClearWave later self-registers?
- Can we whitelist their invoice domain (invoices@clearwave.com) so PO acknowledgements are accepted and not flagged?

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for the packet and the clear answers. We can proceed with a manual provisioning to avoid blocking your first PO. Proposed plan: 

1) Please complete and return the attached vendor enrollment form (I attached a pre-filled PDF for you to sign where possible). If DocuSign is easier, use this envelope: https://www.docusign.com/ENVELOPE/ABCDEF123456
2) We'll create a temporary vendor record in Coupa/Ivalua today and map "ClearWave Managed Services" as a verified DBA under the legal entity "ClearWave Health, Inc." — that prevents duplicate ticketing for now.
3) Procurement (Marcus) — once the temporary vendor is live, please confirm PO format acceptance (we will configure the system to accept CLEAR-####).
4) Invoice routing: we'll whitelist invoices@clearwave.com for acknowledgement and set the remit-to to the address on the tax packet.

Attachments: vendor_enrollment_form_filled.pdf (please sign and return)

I'll mark this as high priority and loop Legal if any tax-entity questions arise, but based on the docs this mapping is standard. Expect confirmation of the temporary account by 2027-03-24 11:00 PST.

Thanks —

Vanessa Ortiz
Platform Operations — Procurement Integrations
